correctness.rationale: The normalized cubic δ(z)^α gives the exact recurrence and explicit first-three coefficients. The discriminant -71199 makes the third weight negative. The standard-library exact checker establishes 18 strictly positive Bernstein polynomials for indices 4–21 and four ratio inequalities at 20 and 21; 285 rational coefficients are checked. The symbolic two-dimensional recurrence maps [4/5,11/10]^2 into its interior for every index n>=22 and order 0<α<1, yielding a complete induction. Step scaling is positive. The exact 52 independent binomial-series comparisons confirm the recurrence implementation; no finite enumeration is used in place of the induction.

value.rationale: The exact order frontier for a standard third-order time-convolution kernel determines precisely when a coefficientwise nonpositive-history condition holds. The nontrivial all-index sign invariant and the isolated second-coefficient sign change are relevant to kernel monotonicity and sign-based numerical stability reasoning, without claiming a complete stability theorem. Neither a finite tabulation nor a BDF2 parameter substitution yields this BDF3 result.
